entities.summary: Dwayne Alonzo "Pearl" Washington was an American professional basketball player who played in the National Basketball Association (NBA). A 6 ft 2 in (1.88 m), 190 pounds (86 kg) point guard, he was best known for his college career for Syracuse University, where he was an All-American.
